verdict.rationale: AgentMail has a human-facing console and dashboard, so a keyboard-driven, fast interface is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents keyboard shortcuts, a command palette, or interface responsiveness for the console. The CLI and API are different ways of operating the product, not keyboard shortcuts or a command palette, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
